subject: Save point
text: Heal up and save before going west to fight Iflyte on B-Floor 8.

evidence.quote: * B-Floor 8 * Heal-up and save your game. Go west to fight the Iflyte.

subject: Iflyte
text: The recommended level to fight Iflyte is 50.

evidence.quote:
BOSS Name:          Iflyte
Recommended Level:  50

subject: Iflyte
text: The best equipment for fighting Iflyte is the Thunder Spear and Cure Spell.

evidence.quote: Best Equipment:     Thunder Spear , Cure Spell

subject: Iflyte
text: Iflyte curls into a ball to roll across the screen, and can be hit in the head when revealed or directly at his center while rolling.

evidence.quote:
This monster curls itself into a ball and rolls across the
screen. Eventually he will stop at the top of the screen and reveal his
body. You are able to strike the monster in his head when he is fully
revealed. You are also able to hit the monster when he is rolling in a
ball, if you strike directly at his center.

subject: Iflyte
text: Defeating Iflyte yields the Rusty Sword.

evidence.quote: Once the Iflyte dies you get the Rusty Sword.

subject: Cibba
text: After exiting the cave, take the Chocobot to Cibba, who tells you to find the Key to Dime Tower and speak to Dr. Bowow.

evidence.quote:
After your character
exits the cave, take you're Chocobot with you and go back to Cibba. He
tells you to find the Key to Dime Tower, and to talk to Dr. BowowSo now
go to Ish and talk to Dr. Bowow.

subject: Desert of Crystal
text: Dr. Bowow in Ish explains that the Nuke spell can blow up a crystal in the Desert of Crystal right outside of Ish.

evidence.quote:
Dr. Bowow says you can use the Nuke
spell to blow up a piece of crystal in the Desert of Crystal. The
Desert of Crystal is right outside of Ish.

subject: Desert of Crystal
text: From outside Ish, go west, north twice, and west, then cast Nuke on the right of two crystals to reveal the entrance hole to Cave of Ruins.

evidence.quote:
* From outside Ish go west, north twice, and west. There should be two
crystals near the middle of the screen. Use the Nuke spell on the right
crystal and it will reveal a hole. Go into the hole into the cave.

subject: Floor 1
text: On Floor 1, go west twice and head down the stairs.

evidence.quote: * Floor 1 * Go west twice and down the stairs.

subject: BFloor 2
text: On BFloor 2, go north and east to open a chest containing the Dragon Shield.

evidence.quote: * BFloor 2 * Go north, east, and open the chest for a Dragon Shield.

subject: BFloor 2
text: From the Dragon Shield chest on BFloor 2, go west, north twice, and west twice to find a chest with the Dragon Sword.

evidence.quote:
Then go west, north twice, west twice, and open the chest for a Dragon
Sword.

subject: BFloor 2
text: From the Dragon Sword chest on BFloor 2, navigate east four times, north three times, and west, then heal and save.

evidence.quote:
Then go east four times, north three times, and west. Now heal-
up/save game.

subject: Mantis Ant
text: The recommended level for Mantis Ant is 53.

evidence.quote:
BOSS Name:          Mantis Ant
Recommended Level:  53

subject: Mantis Ant
text: The recommended best equipment against Mantis Ant is the Dragon Sword and Cure Spell.

evidence.quote: Best Equipment:     Dragon Sword , Cure Spell

subject: Mantis Ant
text: Entering the Mantis Ant fight with the Fire Spell equipped and standing still allows you to defeat the boss without taking damage, winning in about 20 casts.

evidence.quote: However, there is a much easier way to defeat this boss. Have your Fire Spell equipped when you enter the battle. As soon as you enter the screen don't move. Nothing will be able to hit you, and you can cast the Fire Spell at the monster. I was able to win with 20 uses
of the spell.

subject: Dime Tower
text: After killing the Mantis Ant, go through the east door, equip the Rusty Sword, and stand on the odd tile to release its power and raise Dime Tower.

evidence.quote:
When you kill the Mantis Ant the east door opens. Go through the door
and equip the Rusty Sword. Then stand on the odd tile. The power of the
Rusty Sword is released and the Dime Tower will be raised.

subject: Cave of Ruins
text: From outside Cave of Ruins, go south twice, east, south, and west, then walk across the screen to find Dime Tower risen from the sand.

evidence.quote:
From outside the
Cave of Ruins go south twice, east, south, and west. Try to walk across
the screen, and Dime Tower will rise up from the sands.

subject: Ish
text: From outside Ish, Dime Tower is located south and west twice.

evidence.quote:
From outside of Ish, the
Dime Tower is south and west twice.

subject: Marcie
text: Marcie joins the party upon entering Dime Tower and recovers your MP when you ask him.

evidence.quote:
As soon as you walk in, Dr. Bowow's robot Marcie will join you. If you
ASK him he recovers your MP.

subject: Floor 1
text: On Floor 1, go west, north twice, east, break the east wall with a Mattock or Morning Star, then proceed east, north, west, and up the stairs.

evidence.quote:
* Floor 1 * Go west, north twice, east, and use a Mattock/Morning Star
on the east wall. Go through east, north, west, and up the stairs.

subject: Floor 2
text: On Floor 2, go west, south, east, south twice, east, and up the stairs.

evidence.quote: * Floor 2 * Go west, south, east, south twice, east, and up the stairs.

subject: Floor 3
text: On Floor 3, climb the vine north one screen and go through the door.

evidence.quote: * Floor 3 * Now climb the vine north a screen. Now go through the door.

subject: Floor 4
text: On Floor 4, unlock the north door with a Key, then go north and east to find a chest with the Dragon Armor.

evidence.quote:
* Floor 4 * Go west and use a Key on the north door. Go north, east,
and open the chest for the Dragon Armor.

subject: Floor 4
text: From the Dragon Armor chest on Floor 4, go west, break the west wall with a Mattock or Morning Star, then go west and up the stairs.

evidence.quote:
Go west and use a
Mattock/Morning Star on the west wall. Now go west and up the stairs.

subject: Floor 5
text: On Floor 5, going south and resting in a bed restores your HP and MP before heading north and up the stairs.

evidence.quote:
* Floor 5 * Go south and go into a bed to rest. Your HP and MP will be
restored. Go north and up the stairs.

subject: Floor 6
text: On Floor 6, stand in the bottom corners facing away from the trees to chop them with an Axe without killing the monsters, then freeze both monsters.

evidence.quote:
* Floor 6 * There are two monsters surrounded by trees to your south.
You need to freeze both monsters, which can be difficult, since you
don't want to kill them when you chop down the trees. Position your
character in the bottom corners, facing the walls away from the trees.
Now swing your Axe and the trees will be chopped and the enemies
unharmed. Now freeze the monsters and go north.

subject: Floor 6
text: After freezing the monsters on Floor 6, go north, unlock the door with a Key, go east, and go south up the stairs.

evidence.quote:
Use a Key on the door
and go east. Go south and up the stairs.

subject: Garuda
text: The recommended level to fight Garuda on Floor 7 is 55.

evidence.quote:
BOSS Name:          Garuda
Recommended Level:  55

subject: Garuda
text: The best equipment against Garuda is the Flame Chain and Cure Spell.

evidence.quote: Best Equipment:     Flame Chain , Cure Spell

subject: Garuda
text: Garuda dives and throws feathers; wait in a lower corner where the Flame Chain reaches him to destroy feathers and strike him as he swoops.

evidence.quote:
Strategy: Garuda will dive across the screen and throw feathers at you.
Garuda will also swoop down to the middle of the screen and drop more
feathers on you. The trick is to wait in the corner below, but at a
striking distance where the tip of your Flame Chain just reaches
Garuda. Use your Flame Chain to destroy the feathers Garuda drops and
to hit Garuda himself. When he swoops down he will miss you. Then go to
the other corner and attack Garuda again.

subject: Marcie
text: After Garuda is defeated, Dime Tower collapses and Marcie throws the hero across the gap but cannot jump, falling with the tower.

evidence.quote:
Once Garuda is killed go west twice. Just as you are ready to walk on
land, a part of the tower collapses. Marcie tells you that he will
throw you over and then jump himself. After he throws you across the
gap, the hero tells Marcie to jump. Sadly, Marcie is unable to... The
tower will then collapse carrying Marcie with it.

subject: Waterfall
text: After Dime Tower collapses, go west three times to the waterfall, which reverses flow and carries you to the top of the mountain.

evidence.quote:
Once the tower collapses go west
three times to the waterfall. The waterfall fall will reverse its flow.
Walk into the waterfall and it will carry you up to the top of the

subject: Mountain Top
text: At the top of the mountain, go west, north twice, and into the temple of Tower of Gemma.

evidence.quote: Once you are at the top, go west, north twice, and into the temple.

subject: Samurai Warriors
text: Samurai Warriors in the Tower of Gemma can drop Elixirs or the Samurai Armor.

evidence.quote:
The
Samurai Warriors will drop Elixirs or the Samurai Armor.

subject: Demon Head
text: Demon Head enemies in the Tower of Gemma can drop an X-Ether or Samurai Helmet.

evidence.quote:
The Demon Head
will drop an X-Ether or Samurai Helmet.

subject: Elephant
text: Elephant enemies in the Tower of Gemma drop the Aegis Shield.

evidence.quote:
The Elephant will drop the
Aegis Shield.

subject: Floor 1
text: On Floor 1 of Tower of Gemma, go south, east twice, north twice, unlock the north door with a Key, then go north and up the stairs.

evidence.quote:
* Floor 1 * Go south, east twice, north twice, and use a Key on the
north door. Go north and up the stairs.

subject: Dragon
text: The recommended level to fight Dragon on Floor 2 is 57.

evidence.quote:
* Floor 2 * Heal-up and save your game. Go north and a Dragon will
attack.
____________________________________________________________________
BOSS Name:          Dragon
Recommended Level:  57

subject: Dragon
text: Dragon attacks with fireballs that can be blocked with your shield, and can only be damaged by attacks to his head.

evidence.quote:
The dragon attacks with fireballs, which you can luckily
block with your shield. You may only attack the Dragon in the head, his
scales protect him from hits to the body.

subject: Floor 2
text: Once Dragon is defeated, step into the portal in the northeast corner of Floor 2.

evidence.quote: Once he is defeated go into the portal in the northeast corner.

subject: Floor 3
text: On Floor 3, go east and enter the portal.

evidence.quote: * Floor 3 * Go east and into the portal.

subject: Floor 4
text: On Floor 4, go north, west, north, use a Key on the door, then go west and enter the portal.

evidence.quote:
* Floor 4 * Go north, west, north, and use a key on the door.
Go west and into the portal.

subject: Floor 5
text: On Floor 5, go east and enter the portal.

evidence.quote: * Floor 5 * Go east and into the portal.

subject: Floor 6
text: On Floor 6, go south, break the west wall, then go west twice, south, west, and enter the portal.

evidence.quote:
* Floor 6 * Go south and break the west wall. Go west twice, south,
west, and into the portal.

subject: Floor 7
text: On Floor 7, go west and south twice, then steer an icicle with the Ice spell to hit the monster onto the odd tile to open the door.

evidence.quote:
* Floor 7 * Now go west, and south twice. You need to use the Ice spell
and direct your icicle using the control pad. Hit the monster on the
odd tile and the door will open. Go east and up the stairs.

subject: Red Dragon
text: The recommended level to fight Red Dragon on Floor 8 is 58.

evidence.quote:
* Floor 8 * Heal-up and save your game. Go north and the Red Dragon
begins will attack.

BOSS Name:          Red Dragon
Recommended Level:  58

subject: Red Dragon
text: Red Dragon moves in the opposite direction and has more HP than the first Dragon, but shares the same battle strategy.

evidence.quote:
Strategy: The only differences between this boss and the last are that
it moves in the opposite directions and it has more HP. However, the
strategy is still the same as for the first Dragon.

subject: Floor 8
text: After defeating the Red Dragon, enter the portal.

evidence.quote: Once he is defeated go into the portal.

subject: Floor 9
text: On Floor 9, go west and enter the portal.

evidence.quote: * Floor 9 * Go west and into the portal.

subject: Floor 10
text: On Floor 10, go north, east, north, and enter the portal.

evidence.quote: * Floor 10 * Now go north, east, north and into the portal.

subject: Floor 11
text: On Floor 11, go east into the portal, then head south, east twice, and enter the next portal.

evidence.quote:
* Floor 11 * Go east and into the portal. Go south, east twice, and
into the portal.

subject: Pond
text: On Floor 12, unlock the door with a Key and go west to the bottom of the pond to restore HP and MP.

evidence.quote:
* Floor 12 * Use a Key on the door and go west. Go to the bottom of the
pond to restore the Hero's HP and MP. Exit the room and go back into
the portal.

subject: Floor 11
text: After returning to Floor 11, go west, south into the portal, then west into another portal.

evidence.quote:
* Floor 11 * Go west, south, and into the portal. Go west and into the
portal.

subject: Floor 12
text: On Floor 12, unlock the east door with a Key, go east three times, freeze a monster into a snowman, and place it on the odd tile directly above the odd tile in the bottom-left corner.

evidence.quote:
* Floor 12 * Go east and use a Key on the door. Now go east through the
now open door, and go east twice more. In this room you need you need
to freeze a monster. Put the snowman on the odd tile directly above the
odd tile in the bottom-left corner.

subject: Dragon Zombie
text: The recommended level to fight Dragon Zombie is 60.

evidence.quote:
BOSS Name:          Dragon Zombie
Recommended Level:  60

subject: Dragon Zombie
text: Equip a long reach weapon to attack Dragon Zombie's head and destroy fireballs; avoid touching the body, which inflicts about 75 hit points of damage.

evidence.quote:
Strategy: The Dragon Zombie is similar to the dragon you fought back at
the Cave of Marsh. The Dragon Zombie shoots fireballs from his mouths,
and will occasionly move across the screen. Have a long reach weapon
equipped and attack its head. Your weapon is able to destory the
fireballs and your shield can also block them. The fireballs don't deal
you much damage, but if you get hit by the Dragons body, you will lose
about 75 hit points.

subject: Excalibur
text: On Floor 13, go north four times and talk to the Lady, who transforms the Rusty Sword into Excalibur.

evidence.quote:
Once the monster is killed go into the portal.

* Floor 13 * Now go north four times and talk to the Lady (the Girls
mom). She transforms your Rusty Sword into the Excalibur.

subject: Floor 12
text: After opening the door with the snowman puzzle on Floor 12, go north three times, head up the stairs, and heal and save before fighting Dragon Zombie.

evidence.quote:
* Floor 12 *...Once the door is open, go north
three times, and go up the stairs.

* Now heal-up and save your game. Go north and prepare to fight the
Dragon Zombie.

subject: Floor 13
text: On Floor 13, go north twice, west, south, and west to heal up and save your game.

evidence.quote:
* Floor 13 *...Go north
twice, west, south, and west. Heal-up and save your game.
